profile.headline: Senior Big Data Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary:
I'm a Computer Scientist with a Masters in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Dallas with a focus in AI and a Bachelors in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Austin.

I previously worked for Tata Consultancy Services, Ltd. utilizing the Internet of Things and managing manufacturing systems all across North America. I utilized SQL and Java in order to take data and transform them into reports to gain insights into key performance indicators for the sake of monitoring efficiency and catching malfunctions.

I am currently working in Plano, Texas as a Senior Software Engineer for JPMorgan Chase & Co. where I leverage Amazon Web Services' cloud capabilities, along with Python and Java, to develop big data applications for the purposes of extracting, transforming, and loading high volumes of data into distributed cloud systems in a logical business format.

I am a very focused and dedicated individual who is open to learning new tech and processes. I am also involved in my local community, working as a volunteer with the ECLAT foundation (Education Changes Lives and Times) to help provide underprivileged students with the means to follow their dreams and pursue education here in the United States.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Senior Software Engineer in the Architecture, Design, and Engineering section for the Home Lending service in the Chase Consumer and Community Banking line of business, I work to create value by developing frameworks and software which will support the firm and directly serve the customer. I currently work on modernizing the firm’s data infrastructure from a legacy system to big data applications utilizing cloud frameworks.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Modernized important sections of the Home Lending data department
- Created and deployed ETL (Extract, Transform, and Load) pipelines
- Utilized Hadoop and Spark to perform Big Data operations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed a webpage used for validating manufacturing data across all factory sites
-Deployed and maintained failsafe solutions for sites
-Utilized IoT (Internet of Things) technology to monitor and analyze streams of data
-Practiced DevOps and provided quality, ongoing support
-Analyzed and designed database queries and stored procedures
-Updated knowledge and skills regularly through online courses and tests

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a new feature for the back-end service of the TradeStation mobile application.
• Added streaming capabilities to an existing feature of the service layer of both the Android and iOS TradeStation mobile applications.
• Altered the user interface of a front-end feature on the Android TradeStation mobile application.
• Refactored code in the back-end service of the TradeStation mobile application to utilize Go Reflection.
• Migrated application logic from the client-side mobile applications to the back-end streaming service to improve client-side performance and battery usage.
• Added capabilities for language localization to the back-end service.
